# Message codes

Generated for pachifast **0.16.1**.

Every error carries a stable `code` (and `params` for its `{placeholders}`); clients translate from the code. See [Errors and i18n](../guides/errors-and-i18n.md). Codes of your own modules are listed by `pachifast locale check`.

| Code | English | Italian |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `access.permissions_missing` | Missing permissions: {permissions} | Permessi mancanti: {permissions} |
| `access.staff_required` | Staff access required | Accesso riservato allo staff |
| `access.superuser_required` | Superuser access required | Accesso riservato ai superuser |
| `admin.action_not_found` | The action '{name}' does not exist for this model. | L'azione '{name}' non esiste per questo modello. |
| `admin.integrity_error` | The change conflicts with existing data (duplicate or linked rows). | La modifica è in conflitto con dati esistenti (duplicato o righe collegate). |
| `admin.model_not_found` | Model '{app}.{model}' is not administered. | Il modello '{app}.{model}' non è amministrato. |
| `admin.object_not_found` | Row {pk} was not found. | Riga {pk} non trovata. |
| `admin.text.action.delete_selected` | Delete selected | Elimina selezionati |
| `admin.text.deleted_selected` | {count} deleted | {count} eliminati |
| `api.invalid_order_by` | Invalid field '{field}' for ordering. | Campo '{field}' non valido per l'ordinamento. |
